indicators: EMA200 (5m,1h), BB lower, volume_mean_slow, volume pump/drop thresholds
entry_long: (cond1) close>EMA200 AND close>EMA200_1h AND close<BB_lower*safe1 AND volume_mean_slow>shift(30)*pump AND volume<volume[-1]*drop AND (open-close)<(BB_upper-BB_lower)[-2] | (cond2) ... multiple OR blocks
implementation_notes: Ensemble of dip rules; near-duplicate of BigZ04 (see DEDUPE_NOTES). Freqtrade note: minimal_roi/stoploss are part of the published strategy; ROI exits are time-since-entry based. Source file is the sole spec; no independent verification of results.
